response.sql: WITH award_counts AS (SELECT p.bats as hand, COUNT(*) as tally FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(tally) as total_count, COUNT(*) as num_hands FROM award_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT ac.hand, ac.tally, ac.tally * 1.0 / t.total_count as share, 1.0 / t.num_hands as avg_share FROM award_counts ac CROSS JOIN totals t) SELECT hand, tally, share, share - avg_share as excess FROM with_shares WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC;
